sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Flight radar",
  "category": "data",
  "description": "Live aircraft positions around a location over a map of the area, rendered as a compact radar display.",
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "latitude",
      "type": "float",
      "value": "51.5074",
      "required": true,
      "label": "Latitude"
    },
    {
      "name": "longitude",
      "type": "float",
      "value": "-0.1278",
      "required": true,
      "label": "Longitude"
    },
    {
      "name": "radiusKm",
      "type": "float",
      "value": "60",
      "required": true,
      "label": "Radar radius (km)"
    },
    {
      "name": "theme",
      "type": "select",
      "value": "midnight",
      "options": [
        "midnight",
        "ocean",
        "forest",
        "sunset",
        "plum",
        "paper"
      ],
      "label": "Theme"
    },
    {
      "name": "showInfoPanel",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "true",
      "required": true,
      "label": "Show flight information panel"
    },
    {
      "name": "map",
      "type": "select",
      "value": "names",
      "options": [
        "names",
        "lines",
        "off"
      ],
      "label": "Map"
    }
  ],
  "output": [
    {
      "name": "image",
      "type": "image"
    }
  ],
  "permissions": []
}
